summary.text: Steve Jordan is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 151 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia, where he appears as Steven Jordan, lists his career as vice president and general manager of Heavy Duty Trux LTD for 34 years.

paragraphs.text: Steven Jordan's career experience includes serving as vice president and general manager of Heavy Duty Trux LTD for 34 years.
He took office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Herman Morse.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Conservation and Natural Resources and Transportation committees.
